# LingRelay

> OpenAI-compatible LLM API relay service at https://lingrelay.xyz/v1

## Authentication
Bearer token (sk-xxx) generated at https://lingrelay.xyz → 令牌 page.

## Endpoints
- GET /v1/models — list models
- POST /v1/chat/completions — chat (supports stream=true)

## Available Models
deepseek-chat, deepseek-coder, deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3-flash

## Rate Limits
Global ~1000 RPM. Per-token limits configurable. HTTP 429 = rate limited.

## Contact
GitHub Issues.
